author: @joeatwork77

text: Frame Generation does add some latency. However, this is offset by Nvidia Reflex. Nvidia requires reflex to be enabled in order for frame generation to work. Additionally, the game must use Direct X 12 API and you must set Hardware Accelerated GPU Scheduling to the on position. So for a game like Elden Ring, I don’t think Frame Generation is currently supported. Im not sure it ever will be since the game engine is capped at 60 FPS. But in short, I haven’t noticed the added latency thanks to reflex.
